options.content:
# Test Suite Reference

| Dir | Test Name | What It Verifies |
|-----|-----------|-----------------|
| 01 | hub-cluster-ready | Hub nodes Ready |
| 02 | us-cluster-ready | us nodes Ready |
| 03 | eu-cluster-ready | eu spoke up and registered as VM-capable |
| 04 | eu-storage-cluster-ready | eu-storage up; every spoke has a region label |
| 05 | fleet-registration | Fleet `ClusterProfile` us on the hub, region us, VM-capable; kubeconfig Secret |
| 06 | observability-stack | Prometheus, Grafana, Loki healthy; controller ServiceMonitor exists |
| 07 | ingress-log-shipping | Ingress controller, Grafana ingress, event exporter, Loki ready |
| 08 | dashboard-metrics | Grafana dashboards + Prometheus metrics from bucket-binding-controller |
| 09 | dashboard-data | Grafana dashboards render actual Prometheus data |
| 10 | chainsaw-cronjob | Chainsaw runner CronJob exists in monitoring namespace |
| 11 | oidc-trust | Dex issuer contract — ingress URL, token exchange, public client, JWKS |
| 12 | auth-configuration | Spoke kube-apiserver uses AuthenticationConfiguration (dual-issuer) |
| 13 | projected-sa-tokens | Hub OIDC discovery; projected controller token with spoke audience, mounted |
| 14 | platform-admin-access | Admission policies bound; platform-admin manages ClusterRoles, tenants blocked |
| 15 | kubevirt-ready | KubeVirt deployed on eu and us with hardware KVM |
| 16 | vmset-provisioning | VmSetIntent expands into cloud-init Secret + request with tier cpu/memory |
| 17 | vmset-lifecycle | One VmSet runs VMs on eu and us, scale down highest index first, delete cleans both |
| 18 | vm-cloudinit | Cloud-init ran: marker in the VM serial log |
| 19 | vm-console-rbac | VM controller scope and tenant console/read tiers on eu and us |
| 20 | vmset-unschedulable | Region without VMs or a request without a tenant label → Unschedulable, delete not blocked |
| 21 | ceph-rgw-ready | Ceph cluster + RADOS Gateway Ready, bucket StorageClass exists |
| 22 | bucket-provisioning | BucketIntent → quota request → bound claim → endpoint → S3 round trip |
| 23 | bucket-lifecycle | Ceph enforces maxSize/maxObjects; delete removes claim and credentials |
| 24 | bucket-tenant-rbac | Controller scope; tenant tiers; credentials only for admin/developer |
| 25 | bucket-tenant-isolation | Tenant buckets in separate namespaces; no cross-tenant claims or credentials; metrics carry tenant_id |
| 26 | bucket-unschedulable | Region without Ceph or a request without a tenant label → Unschedulable, delete not blocked |
| 27 | workload-issuer | us publishes its token issuer; Dex exchanges a us service-account token |
| 28 | hub-workload-auth | Hub maps the exchanged token to dex:us-workloads:…; humans keep dex:<sub> |
| 29 | hub-tenant-intents | Humans and the workload identity share one RBAC; only tenant principals manage intents in their namespace; offboarding |
| 30 | tenant-kubectl-login | A tenant logs in with kubectl through Dex on every cluster and stays in its namespace |
| 31 | tenant-chart-access | A tenant applies its chart with kubectl, then reaches its VM in each region over ssh and its bucket with curl |
| 32 | management-plane-ready | Metrics-operator, its Metrics and least-privilege RBAC; Prometheus scrapes it; Headlamp sends logins to Dex; the adoption dashboard exists |
| 33 | intent-metrics | Created and ready timestamps per tenant reach Prometheus; time to Ready; every panel of the adoption dashboard shows data |
| 34 | portal-tenant-isolation | A tenant logs in to the portal and works only in its own namespace; the hub trusts the portal's audience, the spokes do not |

---
**Total: 34 test cases**  |  The CronJob runs 12 of them every 2 min (cronjob.tests); the rest via `make validate`
